I will start by listing all orders.

I have listed the refunds. The refunds reported by Alpha Co were: [{'order_id': 350, 'amount_cents': 14396}, {'order_id': 352, 'amount_cents': 9752}, {'order_id': 355, 'amount_cents': 1287}]. The refunds I retrieved using `list_refunds()` are: [{'order_id': 350, 'amount_cents': 14396}, {'order_id': 352, 'amount_cents': 9752}]. The refund for order_id 355 (1287 cents) is missing from the retrieved list, meaning the reported refunds do not match the current system state (or what I can verify). Since the refunds do not match, I must issue a hold.
